app.description: A 3D flight shooter that runs in your browser
app.ogDescription: Dogfight, race through rings and take down a giant kaiju in a 3D flight shooter that runs in your browser. Solo campaign, base defense and 2–4 player online battles and raids. Free, no install.

training.title: Training
briefing: Ten training rings are set up around the island. Fly through the glowing yellow rings in order.
Once you clear them all, two mock enemy fighters will appear above the island.
Shoot both down with your missiles and gun.
Stay inside the combat area (6 km from the island's center).

first-sortie.title: First Sortie
briefing: Unidentified fighters have entered our airspace from the north of the island. This is not a drill.
They will come in one at a time. The first is just probing our defenses. Shoot down all three.
They carry missiles. When the warning sounds, use flares and break hard.

escort.title: Escort
briefing: A transport carrying evacuees will fly from the east coast to the west coast evacuation point.
Four enemy fighters will come after it in two waves.
The transport cannot evade. Drive off the attackers and get it to the west coast.
If the transport is shot down, the mission fails.

strike.title: Strike
briefing: We have located four enemy facilities on the island: a radar, a fuel tank, a hangar and an anti-air gun.
Destroy all of them. The AA gun in the west fires at anything within 2.5 km. When the "AAA" warning appears, turn to break its aim.
The hangar is tough, so use bombs or rockets. The fuel tank explodes; don't pass low right over it.

encounter.title: Encounter
briefing: We have detected two enemy fighters and a huge contact under the sea southeast of the island.
The contact is likely to surface while you are engaging the fighters. Its identity is unknown.
If a giant creature appears, concentrate your fire and drive it back into the sea. Beware of its roar and thrown rocks.
Downing the fighters is optional, but watch your six.

night-intercept.title: Night Intercept
briefing: On a moonlit night, enemy fighters are heading for the island, using the giant creature's appearance as cover.
They come in 3 waves. Wipe out one wave and the next appears. The last wave includes one veteran pilot.
At night enemy markers only show up close. Turn toward the dots on the radar to find them.
If you are shot down, the mission fails. Missiles are resupplied a while after you run out.

flak-line.title: Flak Line
briefing: At a foggy dawn, strike the enemy base on the hills north of the harbor city. Its radar has been signaling a giant shadow in the storm.
Destroy the 4 facilities: the radar, 2 fuel tanks and the hangar. The hangar is tough; use bombs or rockets.
4 AA guns defend the base. When the AAA warning appears, turn out of their line of fire. The guns are optional, but taking them out first makes it easier.
Don't fly into the city's towers.

finale.title: Showdown
briefing: With the base gone, the storm wyvern Nephirga descends on the harbor city. This is the final battle.
Read the tells. Orbs: turn hard or flare. Raised wings: get out of its front. Dive: turn at a right angle.
It is open while resting on a perch and right after you break a part. The body is tough; aim for the wings, head and tail.
If you are shot down, the mission fails. Bring it down within 10 minutes.

raid.title: Raid: Vorgas
briefing: The giant monster Vorgas is coming ashore from the bay, heading for the harbor city's towers.
Glowing shoulder crystals mean a heat beam; a raised tail means a sweep. Read the tells and dodge.
Break a leg to knock it down: it stops and can't attack for a while (on Hard, all parts also take double damage).
Below 40% health it enters the final phase. Defeat it within 5.5 minutes (3.5 on Hard) or it reaches the city. You have 3 lives on both difficulties.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.promptBody: Practice flying, speed, guns, missiles, flares, loops and finding targets in 8 short hands-on chapters. You can redo any chapter later from "Tutorial" in the mode select.
tutorial.safety: This is practice: you cannot be shot down, and hitting the ground puts you back in the air

notice.body: You can now learn what it takes to hit (matching speed, range, the aim marks, finding targets) in hands-on chapters. Try just the chapters you need.

overtake.pad: You flew past it. Pull the right stick down to lower the throttle as you close in

offRange.all: Too far (OUT OF RANGE). Get within 1.5 km before you shoot

lost.direct: Target lost. Push toward the arrow at the screen edge to bring it back in front
lost.classic: Target lost. Bank toward the arrow at the screen edge and pull to bring it back in front
lost.tilt: Target lost. Tilt toward the arrow at the screen edge to bring it back in front

needSpeed.direct: NEED SPEED: too slow. Level off and speed up with AB first
needSpeed.keys: NEED SPEED: too slow. Level off and speed up with {afterburner} (AB) first
needSpeed.pad: NEED SPEED: too slow. Level off and speed up with LB (AB) first

missileHit.direct: Hit. Press FLR as soon as the MISSILE warning appears
missileHit.keys: Hit. Press {flare} as soon as the MISSILE warning appears
missileHit.pad: Hit. Press B as soon as the MISSILE warning appears

replaced.all: The target is back in front of you. Don't fly past it this time

steer.name: Steering
steer.goal: Turn where you want, release to level, climb and dive

text.direct: Push the stick (bottom left) toward where you want to go and the plane turns there. Fly through the 3 yellow rings
text.classic: Push the stick (bottom left) sideways to bank, then pull it back (down) to turn. Fly through the 3 yellow rings
text.tilt: Tilt the device left or right to turn. Fly through the 3 yellow rings
text.drag: Hold your finger where you want to go on the screen and the plane turns there. Fly through the 3 yellow rings
text.keys: Bank with {rollLeft}/{rollRight} and pull with {pitchUp} to turn. Fly through the 3 yellow rings
text.pad: Bank with the left stick and pull it back to turn. Fly through the 3 yellow rings

hint.direct: Keep pushing toward the ring and you keep turning. If you miss, fly away a bit and come back
hint.keys: Bank hard, then pull, to turn quickly. If you miss, fly away a bit and come back
hint.all: If you miss, fly away a bit and come back. The arrow at the screen edge points to the ring

text.direct: Push left or right to turn, then let go. The wings level out and you fly straight
text.classic: Bank about 30° with the stick, then let go. The wings level out (auto-level)
text.tilt: Tilt to turn, then return to your starting grip. The wings level out
text.drag: Hold near a screen edge to turn, then let go. The wings level out
text.keys: Bank about 30° with {rollLeft} or {rollRight}, then release. The wings level out (auto-level)
text.pad: Bank about 30° with the left stick, then release. The wings level out (auto-level)

hint.direct: Push well over, then let go and wait a few seconds
hint.classic: If the wings don't level, turn on Auto-level in Settings → Controls
hint.keys: If the wings don't level, turn on Auto-level in Settings → Controls
hint.pad: If the wings don't level, turn on Auto-level in Settings → Controls
hint.all: Bank, then let go and wait a few seconds

text.direct: Push up to climb, down to dive. Climb 150 m, then descend 150 m
text.classic: Pull the stick back (down) to climb, push it forward (up) to dive. Climb 150 m, then descend 150 m
text.tilt: Tilt the top edge toward you to climb, away to dive. Climb 150 m, then descend 150 m
text.drag: Hold the upper part of the screen to climb, the lower part to dive. Climb 150 m, then descend 150 m
text.keys: {pitchUp} climbs, {pitchDown} dives. Climb 150 m, then descend 150 m
text.pad: Pull the left stick back to climb, push it forward to dive. Climb 150 m, then descend 150 m

hint.all: Watch the altitude number on the right. Small moves are enough

speed.name: Speed
speed.goal: Throttle and AB, flying past, speed match

text.direct: Push the throttle (right edge) all the way up and hold AB to reach 360 m/s (speed is the number on the left)
text.keys: Raise the throttle with {throttleUp} and hold {afterburner} (AB) to reach 360 m/s
text.pad: Push the right stick up for throttle and hold LB (AB) to reach 360 m/s

hint.direct: The throttle alone tops out at 330 m/s. Hold AB (afterburner)
hint.keys: The throttle alone tops out at 330 m/s. Hold {afterburner}
hint.pad: The throttle alone tops out at 330 m/s. Hold LB

text.direct: Now lower the throttle and slow to 220 m/s. Too fast and you fly past targets
text.keys: Now lower the throttle with {throttleDown} and slow to 220 m/s. Too fast and you fly past targets
text.pad: Now pull the right stick down to lower the throttle and slow to 220 m/s. Too fast and you fly past targets

hint.direct: Pull the throttle (right edge) all the way down and wait a moment
hint.pad: Hold the right stick down and wait a moment

text.direct: Stay behind the drone ahead (within 1.4 km) for 4 seconds. As you close in, THR turns orange AUTO and matches your speed (speed match)
text.keys: Stay behind the drone ahead (within 1.4 km) for 4 seconds. Lower the throttle with {throttleDown} as you close in so you don't fly past
text.pad: Stay behind the drone ahead (within 1.4 km) for 4 seconds. Lower the throttle with the right stick as you close in so you don't fly past

hint.direct: Speed match works while your nose points at the drone. If it doesn't, turn on Speed match in Settings → Controls
hint.keys: Close and fast means flying past. Under 1 km, keep the throttle below half
hint.pad: Close and fast means flying past. Under 1 km, keep the throttle below half

gun.name: Aiming and guns
gun.goal: Put the nose mark on the circle, fire when it glows, 1.5 km range

text.direct: Put the nose mark (-○-) on the aim circle ahead of the target. When the circle glows thick white, you'll hit. Beyond 1.5 km the circle is dashed (out of reach)
text.keys: Put the nose mark (-○-) on the aim circle ahead of the target. When the circle glows thick white, you'll hit. Beyond 1.5 km the circle is dashed (out of reach)
text.pad: Put the nose mark (-○-) on the aim circle ahead of the target. When the circle glows thick white, you'll hit. Beyond 1.5 km the circle is dashed (out of reach)

hint.all: Turn toward the target first, then make small corrections up close, within 1.5 km where the circle is solid

text.direct: Shoot down 2 balloons. The gun fires on its own while the circle glows white (auto-fire). GUN works too, but OUT OF RANGE means too far
text.keys: Shoot down 2 balloons. Fire with {fire} when the circle glows white. OUT OF RANGE means too far (get within 1.5 km)
text.pad: Shoot down 2 balloons. Fire with RB when the circle glows white. OUT OF RANGE means too far (get within 1.5 km)

hint.direct: Too close to turn in? Fly away, then come back. If it never fires on its own, turn on Auto-fire in Settings → Controls
hint.all: Too close to turn in? Fly away, then come back. Fire once the circle glows white

moving.name: Moving targets
moving.goal: Shoot down moving drones with the gun

text.direct: Shoot down a moving drone with the gun. The circle leads ahead of them. Come from behind and match speed so you don't fly past
text.keys: Shoot down a moving drone with the gun. The circle leads ahead of them. Come from behind and match speed with {throttleDown} as you close
text.pad: Shoot down a moving drone with the gun. The circle leads ahead of them. Come from behind and match speed with the right stick as you close

hint.all: From the side the circle keeps sliding. Swing in behind the drone, then close in

missile.name: Missiles
missile.goal: Lock and fire, resupply when empty

text.direct: Keep a drone near the center of the screen (within 2.5 km) to LOCK. Lock on first
text.keys: Keep a drone near the center of the screen (within 2.5 km) to LOCK. Lock on first ({targetNext} switches target)
text.pad: Keep a drone near the center of the screen (within 2.5 km) to LOCK. Lock on first (Y switches target)

hint.all: Hold it within 12° of the nose for about a second. Beyond 2.5 km it won't lock

text.direct: While locked, fire a missile with MSL. It chases the target
text.keys: While locked, fire a missile with {missile}. It chases the target
text.pad: While locked, fire a missile with A. It chases the target

hint.direct: If the lock drops, point your nose again. Tap MSL briefly (holding it switches to rockets)
hint.all: If the lock drops, point your nose again

text.direct: Fire the rest of your missiles. A while after you run out, they're resupplied (8 s in the campaign)
text.keys: Fire the rest of your missiles with {missile}. A while after you run out, they're resupplied (8 s in the campaign)
text.pad: Fire the rest of your missiles with A. A while after you run out, they're resupplied (8 s in the campaign)

hint.all: The countdown starts when the ammo count reaches 0. You can fire without a lock

flare.name: Flares
flare.goal: Use them on the missile warning

text.direct: Missiles are coming from behind. When the MISSILE warning appears, release flares with FLR (twice)
text.keys: Missiles are coming from behind. When the MISSILE warning appears, release flares with {flare} (twice)
text.pad: Missiles are coming from behind. When the MISSILE warning appears, release flares with B (twice)

hint.all: It counts while the warning is showing. Too early (before the warning) doesn't count

loop.name: Loops
loop.goal: Loops need speed (NEED SPEED), release at the top to reverse

text.direct: Keep pushing up to loop. Too slow shows NEED SPEED (you can't get over), so speed up with AB first. Loop up to the top (upside down)
text.classic: Keep pulling the stick back to loop. Too slow and you can't get over, so speed up with AB first. Loop up to the top (upside down)
text.tilt: Keep the top edge tilted well toward you to loop. Too slow shows NEED SPEED, so speed up with AB first. Loop up to the top
text.drag: Keep holding the top edge of the screen to loop. Too slow shows NEED SPEED, so speed up with AB first. Loop up to the top
text.keys: Hold {pitchUp} to loop. Too slow and you can't get over, so speed up with {afterburner} (AB) first. Loop up to the top (upside down)
text.pad: Keep pulling the left stick back to loop. Too slow and you can't get over, so speed up with LB (AB) first. Loop up to the top (upside down)

hint.direct: On NEED SPEED, level off and use AB to get above 260 m/s first
hint.all: Level off and use AB to get above 260 m/s, then keep pulling

text.direct: Let go at the top (upside down) and you roll level, flying the other way. Level off facing the opposite direction
text.classic: Let go at the top (upside down) and auto-level rolls you upright, flying the other way. Level off facing the opposite direction
text.tilt: Return to your starting grip at the top (upside down) and you roll level, flying the other way. Level off facing the opposite direction
text.drag: Let go at the top (upside down) and you roll level, flying the other way. Level off facing the opposite direction
text.keys: Release the keys at the top (upside down) and auto-level rolls you upright, flying the other way. Level off facing the opposite direction
text.pad: Release the stick at the top (upside down) and auto-level rolls you upright, flying the other way. Level off facing the opposite direction

hint.all: Let go too late and you finish the loop facing the same way. Let go when the sky is below you

find.name: Picking and finding targets
find.goal: Switch targets, follow the edge arrow when one gets behind you

text.direct: Tap a target on screen to choose it (◇). Pick a different target twice
text.keys: Switch targets (◇) with {targetNext}. Pick a different target twice
text.pad: Switch targets (◇) with Y. Pick a different target twice

hint.direct: Tap the mark of a drone you can see
hint.keys: Each press of {targetNext} moves to the next target
hint.pad: Each short press of Y moves to the next target

text.direct: The target got behind you. Keep pushing toward the arrow at the screen edge (and the red dot on the radar) to bring it in front (twice)
text.classic: The target got behind you. Bank toward the arrow at the screen edge (and the red dot on the radar) and pull to bring it in front (twice)
text.tilt: The target got behind you. Tilt toward the arrow at the screen edge (and the red dot on the radar) to bring it in front (twice)
text.drag: The target got behind you. Hold near the arrow at the screen edge (and the red dot on the radar) to bring it in front (twice)
text.keys: The target got behind you. Bank toward the arrow at the screen edge (and the red dot on the radar) and pull with {pitchUp} to bring it in front (twice)
text.pad: The target got behind you. Bank toward the arrow at the screen edge (and the red dot on the radar) and pull back to bring it in front (twice)

hint.all: BEHIND means directly behind. Keep turning hard either way and it comes around

assist.name: Assists and the practice range
assist.goal: Settings that make hitting easier, and a place to practice
page: In Settings → Controls you can tune how easy hitting is (touch controls).
The assist preset below sets all three at once: Easy (fires and matches speed for you), Normal (you choose when to fire and how fast to fly), Hard (light assist, everything is up to you).
• Aim assist (Low, Standard, High): how strongly the nose is pulled onto the target near the aim circle.
• Auto-fire: fires only while the circle glows white. It never fires out of range.
• Speed match: lowers the throttle as you close on the chosen target so you don't fly past it (THR shows orange AUTO).
• Sensitivity curve: 2.0 makes small stick movements finer (if you overshoot near the circle).
At the practice range you can practice aiming at fixed targets, moving targets and a dummy bandit. The results show what to fix next time.

raidDialog.title: Raid: Vorgas
raidDialog.body: Solo: pick a difficulty and launch right away (Hard: HP ×1.4, shorter tells, 3.5-min final phase, reward ×1.8). For 2–4 players, create a room or join with a room code (everyone on one team; the host picks the difficulty).

defenseDialog.body: Defend the base HQ from all 10 waves. Between waves, pass low and slow over the base (below 300 m, speed under 150) to resupply. Hard: enemies ×1.3, HQ HP 1500. For 2–4 players, create a room or join with a room code (everyone on one team).

save.body: Progress, credits, aircraft and settings are stored in this browser's localStorage, and replays in IndexedDB. Nothing is sent to external servers unless you use Online Link. Clearing browser data deletes them, so you can make a copy under Settings → "Data" → "Save Data".

online.title: Online Link Is Optional
online.body: A server (Supabase) is used only when you sign in under Settings → "Data" → "Online Link". The only information about you is your email address (used only to sign in, never shown to others) and your display name (shown in rankings). Other than that, we send save backups and race / raid / defense records. Turning the link OFF stops uploads and sync.

p2p.title: Multiplayer (P2P)
p2p.body: PvP and co-op exchange game state by direct device-to-device connection (WebRTC / PeerJS). Because you connect directly, other players in the same room can see your IP address (which may reveal your rough location or internet provider). Share room codes only with people you know. The public PeerJS server (0.peerjs.com) is used to set up connections.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.body: The heading font (Rajdhani) is loaded from Google Fonts.

ads.title: Ads & Analytics
ads.body: No ads or analytics are used.

noWebgl2.title: WebGL 2 Not Supported
noWebgl2.body: This browser doesn't support WebGL 2, so SkyRaid can't start. Update your browser (iOS on iPhone / iPad), or open it in one of the browsers below.
